title: ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN
description: Learn how to remove one or more columns from an existing table using ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN.

data.text: SQL Server ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN
The ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN statement removes one or more columns from an existing table. Use it when columns are no longer needed.

data.title: Drop a Single Column
data.content: Removes one column from a table.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE table_name
DROP COLUMN column_name;

data.title: Drop Multiple Columns
data.content: Removes multiple columns in one statement.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE table_name
DROP COLUMN column_name_1, column_name_2, ...;

items: You cannot drop a column that has a CHECK constraint unless you drop the constraint first.
SQL Server does not allow dropping a column that has a PRIMARY KEY or FOREIGN KEY constraint.
If the column is referenced by a view or stored procedure, those objects may break after the column is dropped.

data.text: The following example creates a price_lists table and demonstrates dropping columns.

data.title: Create Price Lists Table
data.content: Creates the price_lists table with a CHECK constraint.
data.code:
CREATE TABLE sales.price_lists(
    product_id int,
    valid_from DATE,
    price DEC(10,2) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT ck_positive_price CHECK(price >= 0),
    discount DEC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    surcharge DEC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    note VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY(product_id, valid_from)
);

data.title: Drop the Note Column
data.content: Drops the note column from price_lists.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE sales.price_lists
DROP COLUMN note;

data.text: The price column has a CHECK constraint, so you cannot drop it directly. You must first drop the constraint.

data.title: Drop CHECK Constraint Then Column
data.content: Drops the CHECK constraint first, then drops the price column.

data.title: Drop Multiple Columns
data.content: Drops the discount and surcharge columns at once.
data.code:
ALTER TABLE sales.price_lists
DROP COLUMN discount, surcharge;

data.title: DROP COLUMN Key Points
points: Use ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN to remove columns from a table.
Drop CHECK constraints before dropping columns that have them.
Cannot drop columns with PRIMARY KEY or FOREIGN KEY constraints.
You can drop multiple columns in a single statement.
